boxes.title: [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Bidder visibility rules')
boxes.s1: (()=>{const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Bidder visibility rules').nextElementSibling; const t=p.firstChild; const r=document.createRange(); r.setStart(t,t.textContent.indexOf('A bidder')); r.setEnd(t, t.textContent.indexOf('quantities.')+11); return r})()
boxes.s2: (()=>{const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Bidder visibility rules').nextElementSibling; const t=p.firstChild; const r=document.createRange(); r.setStart(t,t.textContent.indexOf('Rates, amounts')); r.setEnd(t, t.textContent.length); return r})()
boxes.notHidden: (()=>{const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Bidder visibility rules').nextElementSibling; const t=p.firstChild; const r=document.createRange(); r.setStart(t,t.textContent.indexOf('not hidden')); r.setEnd(t, t.textContent.indexOf('not hidden')+10); return r})()
